mapper.select: SELECT C.CAR_ID AS C_CAR_ID , C.MODEL_ID AS C_MODEL_ID , C.ADMIN_NO AS C_ADMIN_NO , C.CAR_YEAR AS C_CAR_YEAR , C.CAR_MILEAGE AS C_CAR_MILEAGE , C.CAR_PRICE AS C_CAR_PRICE , C.CAR_DESCRIPTION AS C_CAR_DESCRIPTION , C.CAR_STATUS AS C_CAR_STATUS , C.CAR_CREATED_AT AS C_CAR_CREATED_AT , CI.CAR_IMAGE_ID AS CI_CAR_IMAGE_ID , CI.CAR_ID AS CI_CAR_ID , CI.IS_PRIMARY AS CI_IS_PRIMARY , CM.MODEL_ID AS CM_MODEL_ID , CM.MODEL_NAME AS CM_MODEL_NAME , CM.BRAND_ID AS CM_BRAND_ID , CB.BRAND_ID AS CB_BRAND_ID , CB.BRAND_NAME AS CB_BRAND_NAME FROM CARS C LEFT JOIN CAR_IMAGES CI ON C.CAR_ID = CI.CAR_ID LEFT JOIN CAR_MODELS CM ON C.MODEL_ID = CM.MODEL_ID LEFT JOIN CAR_BRANDS CB ON CM.BRAND_ID = CB.BRAND_ID

, CM.MODEL_ID AS CM_MODEL_ID , CM.MODEL_NAME AS CM_MODEL_NAME , CM.BRAND_ID AS CM_BRAND_ID , CB.BRAND_ID AS CB_BRAND_ID , CB.BRAND_NAME AS CB_BRAND_NAME FROM CARS C LEFT JOIN CAR_IMAGES CI ON C.CAR_ID = CI.CAR_ID LEFT JOIN CAR_MODELS CM ON C.MODEL_ID = CM.MODEL_ID LEFT JOIN CAR_BRANDS CB ON CM.BRAND_ID = CB.BRAND_ID WHERE C.CAR_ID = #{carId}
